The first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. The Write tool reported success, but I didn't re-read the file afterwards.

The Muninn session-start context also carried a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it.
